[ASSISTANT_SAID] Morality differs significantly across various cultures and belief systems; examples include polygamy, capital punishment, abortion, homosexuality, animal rights, and euthanasia.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Polygamy is acceptable in some cultures, such as many African tribes, while it is prohibited in others, like Western cultures.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Abortion is illegal in some countries, such as Ireland and Malta, while it is fully legal in others, such as Canada and most of Western Europe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Homosexuality is considered sinful or criminal in many cultures, particularly in the Middle East and Africa, but is accepted in countries like the United States, Canada, and Western Europe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Some societies treat animals as equals, while others view them as resources, such as in the meat and dairy industry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Euthanasia is legal in some countries like Belgium and the Netherlands, but illegal in others.
